title: Myllypuro Active Ageing & Fall Prevention Companion
challenge_statement: Elderly citizens in Helsinki face mobility isolation and fall risks. How can we combine non-invasive computer vision, physiotherapeutic exercise routines, and empathetic voice guidance to empower independent living?

work_packages.contribution: Validates exercise movements, assesses clinical fall-risk factors, and ensures patient safety standards.
Develops privacy-first posture tracking using local edge AI (PoseNet/YOLO) without sending camera feeds to the cloud.
Designs high-contrast, large-format interfaces and intuitive conversational prompts for elderly users with varying cognitive agility.

work_packages.role: Municipal Health Service Model & Grant Strategist
work_packages.contribution: Analyzes procurement viability for Helsinki City (Sosiaali- ja terveystoimiala) and calculates healthcare cost savings.

academic_potential: Peer-reviewed paper on 'Multidisciplinary Approaches to Privacy-Preserving Computer Vision in Geriatric Physiotherapy' for the Finnish Society of Telemedicine and eHealth.

title: Arabia Circular Textile Passport & Gamified Upcycling
challenge_statement: Post-consumer textile waste in the Helsinki capital region is surging. How can digital product passports, blockchain/QR tracing, and participatory community design incentivize citizens to repair, repurpose, and recycle clothing?

work_packages.contribution: Develops upcycling design patterns, modular garment concepts, and visual repair documentation.
Builds the digital garment passport data model, QR integration, and lightweight carbon footprint estimator.

work_packages.role: Circular Business Model & Second-Life Market Strategist
work_packages.contribution: Designs resale economics, deposit-return incentives, and commercial partnerships with Nordic retailers like Emmy and Tori.

academic_potential: Case study on circular economy transitions published in the Nordic Journal of Architectural Research or Waste Management & Research.

title: Karamalmi Smart Microgrid & Campus Carbon Nudge Dashboard
challenge_statement: Energy consumption spikes during laboratory and server operations. How can smart IoT telemetry combined with behavioural economics and gamification motivate students and staff to balance campus peak loads?

work_packages.role: IoT Sensor Integration & Energy Forecasting Engineer
work_packages.contribution: Connects building telemetry (Modbus/BACnet) to a time-series predictor predicting consumption spikes.
Creates digital signage and ambient light displays in campus lobbies indicating live carbon intensity.
Implements intra-campus energy-saving competitions with cafe voucher rewards funded by utility cost reductions.

academic_potential: Submission to IEEE SmartGridComm or European Conference on Information Systems (ECIS).
